paragraphs.text: Pontotoc’s boys swimming team has won the 2026 MHSAA Class II state championship, the school’s athletics department announced late Saturday, Oct. 17.
Pontotoc Athletics shared a championship graphic and a team photograph showing the swimmers with their state championship trophy and Class II boys banner.
